scripts.dev:setup: npm run prisma:generate && node --env-file=.env --env-file=.env.local ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --schema=prisma/platform.prisma && node --env-file=.env --env-file=.env.local ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js migrate deploy --schema=prisma/shop.prisma && node --env-file=.env --env-file=.env.local ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs prisma/seed.ts
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v --remove-orphans && npm run dev:db && npm run dev:setup
scripts.build: prisma generate --schema=prisma/platform.prisma && prisma generate --schema=prisma/shop.prisma && next build
scripts.db:push: prisma db push --schema=prisma/platform.prisma && prisma db push --schema=prisma/shop.prisma
